verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests manuscript content covering remote and hybrid leadership interview questions.
The client establishes a flexible 4,000–6,000-word acceptance guideline for each new manuscript chapter.
The client accepts the proposed 4,000–6,000-word chapter range, changing the manuscript chapter-length acceptance condition.
The client defines this manuscript chapter as question-and-answer content with author-selected question count under the total book limit; the prior chapter-length key exists and is correctly removed.
The client explicitly ends the project, removing the outstanding remote and hybrid leadership chapter deliverable.
